title: Shoggoth wall art — round 02 mood board
notes: 7 of 12 planned cards. Wikimedia rate limits blocked 5 slots (ids 03, 04, 06, 08, 12) after 20+ paced attempts over 2.5h; Printables is behind a bot challenge. Shortfall concentrated in cutesy-horror and wall-integration axes; round-03 trawl should lead with those.

cards.title: Plush octopus, dark grey, big eyes
cards.rationale: Soft, benign tentacle creature in dark fabric; probes how far the shoggoth can go toward plush-friendly before it stops reading as horror (round-01: Evan asked for a mild cutesy aesthetic).

cards.title: Plush Cthulhu on granite marker
cards.rationale: Chibi Cthulhu as a toy; probes whether a smiling, simplified tentacle face works if the form stays mythos-legible (replaces the dead literal-mask axis).

cards.title: Casa Batlló organic facade
cards.rationale: Gaudí facade with scale-tile roof and bone-like window frames; probes ornament growing out of the wall plane rather than a contained silhouette (round-01: Giger Bar columns merging with wall were loved).

cards.title: Mosaic octopus sprawled across plane
cards.rationale: Pink mosaic octopus with tentacles spreading freeform across a flat plane (ground analog for wall spread); probes uncontained-silhouette spread (round-01: 05 note), and the playful mosaic skin doubles as a mild-cutesy signal.

cards.title: Beksiński S4 (2004)
cards.rationale: Beksiński figures dissolving into web-like crust; cold blue-grey variant of the loved AA78 surface, probes whether a pale petrified palette beats ochre.

cards.title: Brain coral colony, ochre ridges
cards.rationale: Dense meandering ridges in ochre; probes a coral/brain-fold texture as a decor-compatible organic surface in place of Giger ribbing.

cards.title: Cthulhu statue, verdigris patina
cards.rationale: Hand-painted Cthulhu figure in mottled green-black patina; probes a bronze/verdigris paint finish that reads as decor sculpture, not gothic prop.
